newsitem.title: MEXICO: GFBanorte to set up pension fund firm.
newsitem.headline: GFBanorte to set up pension fund firm.

text.p: Grupo Financiero Banorte plans to invest 50 million pesos in creating a pension fund management firm, or Afore, the banking group's director, said on Thursday.
At a news conference, the director, Othon Ruiz Montemayor, said the bank was looking for a foreign partner to help set up the firm and was already entertaining offers.

Private pension funds are due to start operating in Mexico in mid-1997, six months behind the original schedule. The government delayed the launch to iron out technical problems and to provide some budgetary breathing space.
Ruiz Montemayor said the group would set up a new pension and insurance division to handle the business. Enrique Castillon will head the operation.
The bank has already sought authorization from Mexican authorities to set up the Afore. It initially aims to control three percent of accounts in the Mexican pension system, Ruiz Montemayor said.
The initial investment of 50 million pesos is double the minimum capitalization required Mexican pension authorities.
